final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), s2 AS (SELECT region, SUM(total) AS rtotal FROM s1 GROUP BY region) SELECT s1.account_id, s1.region, s1.total, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.total AS REAL) / s2.rtotal AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.region = s2.region ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
